summary: Commission diagnostics + broker backfill acceptance matrix (6 criteria) verified: 4 new backend test files + 2 new browser checks, all passing. Feature already implemented server+client side (explain()/_kg() tonnes normalisation in lib/commission.py, POST /api/policies/set-broker + PUT /policies/{id}/broker, PATCH /api/users/{id} agent-default-broker backfill in routers/users.py, CommissionPanel 'commission-misses' details panel, BulkBroker component on /policies). No app bugs found. One environment fixup applied: admin kumararaja's must_change_password flag had been left True by an earlier test iteration (contradicting the briefing's documented state) and was blocking all new browser checks behind a forced password-change dialog -- reset to False in Mongo to match seed_facts, not an application bug.

checks.criterion: User bug: broker-scoped rule not applied to policies with no broker_id -- diagnose via misses reasons, fix via bulk set-broker
checks.name: test_tscheck_set_broker_commission_fix.py
checks.evidence: Created tscheck broker + receivable rule (National Insurance, broker-scoped, products=['GCV'], gvw 16500-34000, net_percent=15). Inserted policy (National Insurance Company Limited / Goods Carrying / Package / gvw=18500 / net_premium=40000, no broker_id) directly in Mongo. GET /policies/{id}/commission -> receivable=null, misses[0].reasons=["Policy broker is 'not set', rule needs tscheck-broker-..."]. POST /api/policies/set-broker {policy_ids:[id], broker_id} -> updated=1. Re-GET commission -> receivable=6000 (15% of 40000). Flaky once under pytest-xdist parallel contention with other files racing on the shared commission_rules collection (consistent with iteration 6/7/8 findings); passed cleanly on 4/4 isolated reruns -- classified flaky, not a bug.

checks.name: test_tscheck_gvw_tonnes_normalised.py
checks.evidence: Receivable rule gvw_min=16500/gvw_max=34000. Policy fields.gvw=18.5 (tonnes form) -> GET /policies/{id}/commission -> receivable=2000 (10% of 20000 net premium), receivable_rule_name matches the rule -- confirms lib/commission.py _kg() treats 18.5 as 18500kg and the rule still matches.

checks.name: test_tscheck_default_broker_backfill.py
checks.evidence: Agent had one policy with no broker and one already on broker_b. PATCH /api/users/{agent_id} {broker_id: broker_a.id} -> 200. GET on the brokerless policy -> broker_id/broker_name now broker_a. GET on the policy that already had broker_b -> unchanged (still broker_b) -- backfill only fills policies with no broker, does not overwrite existing ones.

checks.name: test_tscheck_set_broker_access_control.py
checks.evidence: Logged in as a freshly created tscheck agent. POST /api/policies/set-broker -> 403. GET /api/policies/{id}/commission -> 403. Both reviewer/admin-only endpoints correctly reject the agent role.

checks.criterion: Bulk Set broker in Policy MIS UI
checks.name: bulk-set-broker-in-policies-ui
checks.evidence: Admin logged in, /policies search for fixture policy no. -> selected its row via policies-select-all -> policies-selection-bar appeared with bulk-broker-select + bulk-broker-apply-button. Picked the tscheck broker, applied -> toast 'Broker set to tscheck-broker-bulkui on 1 policy -- commission recalculated' visible. Row's Broker column now shows the broker name and Comm. receivable cell updated from blank to ₹1,000 (matching the fixture's scoped receivable rule). Script resets the fixture policy's broker to null via API at start for rerun-safety. Re-ran once through the public preview URL https://insurance-mis-portal.preview.emergentagent.com -- passed there too.

checks.name: policy-detail-shows-commission-misses
checks.evidence: Opened the brokerless fixture policy's detail page -> commission-panel visible, commission-receivable shows '--', commission-misses <details> visible and auto-expanded (open when receivable is null); expanding shows reasons including "Policy broker is 'not set', rule needs ..." for each mismatched broker-scoped rule.

action_items: Fixed environment drift, not an app bug: admin kumararaja's must_change_password had been left true by a prior iteration's check residue, blocking the UI behind a forced password-change modal on every login. Reset to false in Mongo to restore the briefing's documented state (must_change_password false) before running new browser checks.

Pre-existing, out-of-scope (re-confirmed, matches iteration 6/7/8 notes): running test_tscheck_set_broker_commission_fix.py together with other commission-rule test files under pytest-xdist parallelism shows an occasional flake on the 'closest miss' ordering because workers race on the shared commission_rules collection. Passed 4/4 in isolated reruns -- not re-diagnosed further as it is the same documented xdist-contention issue, not a bug introduced by this feature.
